capabilities.title: Skills SDK check facade
capabilities.next_slice: Broaden check coverage only when a later slice adds new executable SDK surfaces.
capabilities.notes: The facade routes through the canonical skill doctor and emits a receipt.

capabilities.title: Manifest schema spine
capabilities.next_slice: Extend the schema only when new manifest fields have executable owners.
capabilities.notes: Schema spine tests cover the current manifest contract.

capabilities.title: Check receipt schema
capabilities.next_slice: Add receipt families for later executable install or publish lanes.
capabilities.notes: The check facade emits schema-shaped receipt evidence.

capabilities.title: Risk classification
capabilities.next_slice: Connect risk tiers to real adapters only after those adapters are approved.
capabilities.notes: Risk classification is local and read-only.

capabilities.title: SkillIR.v0 typed spine
capabilities.next_slice: Use SkillIR.v0 as the shared model before package build, eval runner, signing, sandbox, emitters, or docs projection generation consume it.
capabilities.notes: The SDK can now build a read-only typed intermediate representation for a canonical skill source without claiming package emitters or registry readiness.

capabilities.title: Package identity build
capabilities.next_slice: Connect package identity to signed archive emission only after signing, redaction, and archive ownership policy are approved.
capabilities.notes: Builds a digest-backed package identity receipt from SkillIR.v0 without emitting archives, signing, registry, or publish behavior.

capabilities.title: Read-only install preview
capabilities.next_slice: Real install writes require a separately approved lifecycle slice.
capabilities.notes: The SDK models target paths and lockfile delta without writing them.

capabilities.title: Read-only lockfile preview
capabilities.next_slice: Lockfile write/update is covered by PU-009 real project install receipts.
capabilities.notes: The preview reports the intended lockfile delta with would_write false.

capabilities.title: Real install writes
capabilities.next_slice: Extend cleanup to richer restore semantics only when install receipts carry before-state proof.
capabilities.notes: PU-009 performs bounded project installs only when --apply and an explicit marked --project-root are supplied; PU-010 consumes those receipts for cleanup.

capabilities.title: Project conformance adoption gate
capabilities.next_slice: Wire project conformance into broader repo adoption policy only after the read-only SDK project gate is stable.
capabilities.notes: PU-012 inspects explicit marked project roots, lockfiles, receipts, and installed file digests without mutating project state.

capabilities.title: SDK lens selection
evidence_refs: ./bin/ask sdk lenses select --prompt 'review a skill for validation confidence' --intent validation_review --json --robot
capabilities.next_slice: Use selected lenses to route bounded reviews; keep lens selection read-only and evidence-backed.
capabilities.notes: PR 242 added deterministic lens catalog validation, explain, list, and selection receipts without mutating repo state.

capabilities.title: Lens-routed review plan receipts
capabilities.next_slice: Use review plan receipts to hand off bounded human or agent reviews without treating the receipt as review completion.
capabilities.notes: PU-014 turns deterministic lens selection into read-only review route receipts; it does not run reviewers, CI, or external services.

capabilities.title: Review handoff receipts
capabilities.next_slice: Execute bounded reviewer agents only after handoff receipts define roles, required artifacts, and not-proven lanes.
capabilities.notes: PU-015 consumes verified review-plan receipts and emits read-only review handoff receipts; it does not run reviewers, CI, or external services.

capabilities.title: Governed local review artifact execution
capabilities.next_slice: Keep review execution receipts routed through SDK status truth before broadening reviewer execution or external readiness claims.
capabilities.notes: PU-017 materializes required local review artifacts from review handoff receipts. PU-018 locally implements compact governed stage skill shape through validator, scaffold, migrated stage packages, and bounded source-context reference metadata while preserving explicit not-proven lanes for independent approval, CI, PR, review-thread, tracker, and merge-readiness state.

capabilities.title: Review artifact verification receipts
capabilities.next_slice: Add governed reviewer execution only after local required-artifact verification is stable and still separated from external PR, CI, review-thread, tracker, and merge-readiness lanes.
capabilities.notes: PU-016 consumes review handoff receipts and verifies required local review artifacts without running reviewers or external services.

capabilities.title: Determinism audit
capabilities.next_slice: Promote individual audit candidates through scoped validator or skill-authoring slices after owner review.
capabilities.notes: PR 242 added an advisory read-only audit that reports deterministic improvement candidates; candidates are not failures.

capabilities.title: Local trust ledger
evidence_refs: ./bin/ask sdk trust decide Infrastructure/tests/fixtures/skills_sdk/valid_skill --decision trust --reason 'fixture passed local checks' --owner skills-sdk-tests --preview --json --robot
capabilities.next_slice: Connect trust decisions to release-mode policy only after revocation, expiry, and owner workflows have stronger evidence.
capabilities.notes: PU-025 appends local JSONL trust decisions only when --apply is explicit; it does not mutate a global trust store or claim runtime trust.

capabilities.title: Redacted observability feedback preview
capabilities.next_slice: Connect feedback candidates to generated eval-case drafts only after candidate promotion is guarded by package and eval receipts.
capabilities.notes: PU-026 mines local redacted JSONL events into preview-only eval scenario and skill-gap candidates; raw prompt/output fields block the receipt and no promotion or file generation is performed.

capabilities.title: Reference ingestion / knowledge capsules
capabilities.next_slice: After the route-truth declutter slice, add no-network fixture coverage and runtime projection proof for vendored capsule discoverability.
capabilities.notes: PU-019 now has a first implemented Skills SDK consumer lane: validate a portable KnowledgeOS extraction, preflight the staged skill package, vendor references into the skill, update capsule routing, and run package proof without making runtime depend on KnowledgeOS.

capabilities.title: Eval execution
capabilities.next_slice: Use eval profiles to add Codex-backed A/B execution only after the preview receipt stays schema- and docs-verified.
capabilities.notes: The SDK routes to the existing internal skill-builder eval backend, preserves internal scorecard case counts and calibrated quality-gate assertions in SDK receipts, binds targeted receipts to package identity, and keeps deterministic JSONL as a fast fixture lane; Tessl remains opt-in.

capabilities.title: Eval runner and judge profiles
capabilities.next_slice: Use the previewed profiles to drive Codex-backed A/B execution receipts without exposing judge secrets or authenticated Codex judge state to skill execution.
capabilities.notes: The SDK now previews Codex exec sandbox profiles and post-run judge profiles: local Ollama uses qwen3.5:latest, Ollama Cloud uses deepseek-v4-flash:cloud with OLLAMA_API_KEY, Codex fast uses gpt-5.3-codex-spark through an authenticated Codex CLI boundary, and judge secrets are kept out of the candidate skill execution environment.

capabilities.title: Canonical A/B scoring rubric
capabilities.next_slice: Use this rubric digest for local Ollama judge execution before adding cloud DeepSeek and Tessl confirmation receipts.
capabilities.notes: The SDK now exposes one stable A/B scorecard for local qwen3.5:latest, cloud deepseek-v4-flash:cloud, and later Tessl validation. Judge outputs remain advisory until calibrated and must include dimension scores, evidence refs, and per-dimension reasons.

capabilities.title: Codex-backed A/B eval preview
capabilities.next_slice: Invoke codex exec for each variant only after the preview receipt, evidence directory contract, and judge input redaction contract are schema-verified.
capabilities.notes: The SDK now previews a Codex-backed skill A/B experiment contract with skill A/B package identity, fixture digest, Codex execution profile, judge profile, and judge-secret isolation. It does not invoke codex exec, Ollama, network, winner selection, or mutation.

capabilities.title: Codex-backed A/B eval execution plan
capabilities.next_slice: Invoke codex exec only after command-plan receipts, evidence root handling, and prompt redaction are verified against real runner output.
capabilities.notes: The SDK now emits the exact Codex exec command argv, prompt digests, and planned evidence paths for both variants without invoking Codex, Ollama, network, winner selection, or mutation.

capabilities.title: Codex-backed A/B eval execution
capabilities.next_slice: Add sanitized evidence comparison and LLM-as-judge scoring after Codex execution receipts are stable and calibrated judge labels exist.
capabilities.notes: The SDK now has an explicit --execute-gated Codex A/B run command that writes bounded prompt/stdout/stderr/last-message evidence, records one result per variant, and keeps judge provider invocation false until a separate scoring receipt is added.

capabilities.title: Codex-backed A/B judge input preview
capabilities.next_slice: Invoke the selected judge profile only after calibration labels and decision-quality gates are added.
capabilities.notes: The SDK can now derive a sanitized A/B judge input payload and prompt digest from a completed ab-run receipt without invoking Ollama, Codex judge state, network, or mutation. The local default judge profile is Ollama qwen3.5:latest.

capabilities.title: Scenario quality gate
capabilities.next_slice: Connect generated or observed eval candidates to this gate before promotion into release-mode eval runs.
capabilities.notes: PU-030 previews scenario promotion quality from references/evals.yaml without mutating scenario sources, running evals, or promoting generated candidates.

capabilities.title: Package verification
capabilities.next_slice: Connect package verification to signed publish only after signing is approved.
capabilities.notes: Package verification is local and read-only.

capabilities.title: Package signing intent
capabilities.next_slice: Approve real signing adapter, key ownership, archive emission, and redaction authority before producing signatures.
capabilities.notes: The SDK validates signing policy and package digest intent without requesting signatures, accessing key material, emitting artifacts, or mutating trust state.

capabilities.title: Sandbox boundary validation
capabilities.next_slice: Add external skill intake quarantine receipts and Codex exec A/B execution receipts before claiming live sandbox execution evidence.
capabilities.notes: The SDK only previews and validates sandbox boundary policy. It does not own a custom runtime sandbox: external skill intake should use quarantine-style validation, and eval A/B execution should use Codex sandbox modes through codex exec.

capabilities.title: Security adapter detection
capabilities.next_slice: Connect discovered adapters to scanner execution receipts only after credential, network, and ownership boundaries are approved.
capabilities.notes: PU-031 discovers local configured scanner adapter surfaces from repo workflows and config without running scanners, reading credentials, using network, or mutating state.

capabilities.title: Static local documentation artifacts
capabilities.next_slice: Keep the HTML artifacts projection-only from SDK capability status before any hosted explorer or docs expansion.
capabilities.notes: Local browser artifacts exist as visual projections of ./bin/ask sdk status; no hosted docs pipeline is claimed.

capabilities.title: Static explorer index preview
capabilities.next_slice: Add hosted explorer rendering only after ownership, publishing, and freshness contracts are approved.
capabilities.notes: PU-029 previews capability and skill indexes from JSON/source manifests only; it does not render HTML or publish a hosted explorer.

capabilities.title: Local Codex plugin readiness

capabilities.title: Publish

capabilities.title: Package hardening
